title: SIDE RAIL WEATHER STRIP
summary: Convertible (19467) soft top side rail weatherstrips (the rubber seals along the top's side rails that the door glass seals against): front and rear sections along the horizontal side rail and a vertical rear section down the rear rail. They are screwed up into the top's side rail frame from below, with nuts on the rail studs, set in sealing compound and lubricated at the glass contact.
